mission: Close E10-F2: side decision used ONLY declared handedness and never cross-checked the measured dominant-motion wrist, so a left-hand swing under a right-handed declaration committed mirrored BACKHAND at 0.80.

change.mechanism: The side decision now cross-checks the measured dominant-motion wrist (dominantWristInfo, ±200ms travel) against the declared handedness. Declared intent stays context, not evidence. If the dominant-motion wrist contradicts the declaration DECISIVELY (both wrists measured in >=MIN_TRAVEL_SAMPLE_FRAMES=5 frames AND off-declaration wrist travel >= 1.5x declared-wrist travel), the heuristic abstains at depth 1 with explicit limiting factor 'declared_handedness_contradicted_by_dominant_motion_wrist'. If the contradiction is non-decisive (sparse rival measurement or ratio < 1.5, e.g. two-handed backhands where both wrists move together), it does NOT abstain but degrades side confidence to the DEGRADED_CONFIDENCE_CAP=0.6 and appends limiting factor 'declared_handedness_unconfirmed_by_dominant_motion_wrist'.
change.contractVersioning: No thresholds/denominators weakened; classifier version bumped (stroke-heuristic-5, lite 3.1) instead of softening in place.
